title: Overview
description: Every Iris part, foundation and layout, with live previews, exact tokens and the rules that hold them. For people and for LLMs.

title: Meaning: what may go where
description: Every drawing in Iris says something. An orb is Iris, light means she is working, her hand means something personal, a colour means a kind of thing. Nothing is a picture to fill a corner.
headings: One rule over all of it
Each state, when it is true
Light: she is working on it
Decoration: the only things allowed to just look nice
You: what you chose, and what she thinks of you
Many of her: roles in a team room
Neighbours: what may stand next to what

title: Colour
description: Iris is a calm ground, near-black or soft near-white as the system is, frosted glass and one ice-blue accent. Colour carries meaning here, it is never decoration.
headings: Fifteen topics, one accent per screen
What may never be a colour

title: Type
description: Quiet type. The system font, eight named sizes, mono for labels and values. Nothing shouts, and nothing is invented.
headings: Three stacks and where the faces come from
Two sizes the tokens carry outside --text-*

title: Shape
description: One shape holds the whole product: a frosted glass card, radius 18, with a 1px light on its edge. Pills for everything you press.

title: Elevation
description: Iris has no shadows on cards. Light on the edge does the work, and a shadow appears only over the page.

title: Motion
description: Two durations the parts already used, three the system now names, one house curve, and her ring.
headings: Reduced motion is a hard rule

title: Interaction
description: Every touch gets an answer you can see, and on a phone one you can feel. Nothing arrives or leaves in one frame, and nothing moves that nobody asked for.
headings: Three rules over all of it

title: State
description: What a part does when a hand answers it, the layer values behind that answer, and the floor underneath.
headings: The layer values, state by state

title: Spacing
description: Three tokens on a page, one rhythm inside a card, and every number the parts use.

title: Layout
description: A phone in the hand, a window she opens, and a wide screen hold the same file. What changes is how many panes it may show and where the navigation sits.
headings: The same file at three widths
Which app layout for which content
Where the tab bar sits, where the sidebar takes over

title: Icons
description: One line set, drawn by the system. Fourteen shapes ship, at four sizes, and no screen draws its own.
headings: When an icon may stand alone

title: Accessibility: what it holds, and what it owes
description: Contrast, target size, focus, motion and words: what the system holds today, and what it still owes.
headings: What is tested, and what is not

title: Edge
description: The apps' light patterns along an edge: round her orb while she thinks, along a screen while it reloads. The TalkOrb and the Orb3D think with it.

title: EdgeText
description: A word as a neon sign: the Edge light runs along the outline of every letter. SVG and CSS only.

title: MacPill
description: The Mac: her orb low on the desktop, with the bar that grows out from behind it when the hand rests on it.

title: Mark
description: Her ring as a still, sharp mark, from the brand kit's 1024px render with its glow. For a logo, a lock screen, an empty page.

title: Orb
description: Any where you show that Iris is there: the header of a screen, a hero, the logo.

title: Orb3D
description: A hero moment, the Mac pill or the talk button, where one or two live orbs carry the screen.

title: TalkOrb
description: The talk button: the middle of the iPhone tab bar, and the Mac pill. Hold it to talk.

title: Button
description: A single action or decision; the browser build of the app's pill button.

title: ButtonGroup
description: The button set of one screen in its topic: primary flat, secondary glass, the quieter kinds beside them.

title: Chip
description: One choice among a few in a topic: a shop, a day, a filter.

title: DatePicker
description: A month you pick a day in: one accent on the chosen day, today marked with a ring.

title: Field
description: One line of input inside a card: a search box, an add line, a short answer.

title: Menu
description: A list of choices on its own surface: a filter, a sort, a set of actions, anchored to the thing it belongs to.

title: SearchField
description: Finding something: a pill field that says what it is doing and clears itself.

title: Select
description: One choice out of a few, in the shape of the fields around it.

title: Slider
description: One value on a line: how much, how far, how loud.

title: SplitButton
description: One action, and the caret that opens the others that belong to it.

title: TextArea
description: The multi-line field: a note, a message, anything longer than a line.

title: TimePicker
description: A time you set with two strips: the hour, then the minute. The chosen time reads big, in mono.

title: Toggle
description: A setting that is on or off and takes effect at once.

title: Card
description: Every group of content on the near-black page: one panel, one surface, no second style.

title: Carousel
description: A strip of cards you swipe or scroll sideways, with dots that say where you are.

title: CheckList
description: A short list of things to do, ticked in the topic colour or ordered by time.

title: Divider
description: A hairline that groups what is above it from what is below.

title: Photo
description: A photo with a depth map: a word behind the person, duotone in the topic's colours, or parallax in four depth layers. No photo ships: without a src it paints its own neutral scene with a matching depth map, and without a depth map it guesses one (lower and central is nearer).

title: Row
description: One line of a settings page: icon, title, the dim line under it, and a control on the right.

title: Stat
description: One number and one word, at the top of a card or a window.

title: Dialog
description: The one place Iris interrupts: a decision that cannot wait, with the action that matters first.

title: Sheet
description: Secondary content anchored to an edge: the bottom on a phone, the side on a wide window.

title: VaultAsk
description: The vault's question, the same on every device: who asks, from where, why, what it does and how far it reaches, then allow or no.

title: AppBar
description: The top line of a screen or a window: what this is, and the few actions that belong to it.

title: Badge
description: A count or a dot on the thing it belongs to: a tab, an icon, a word.

title: ChatStack
description: Every chat with its loops as a card in its topic's colour, stacked with depth; a tap fans them out, a tap on one opens that chat with its loops and actions.

title: CircleStack
description: Every chat with its loops as a circle, stacked behind the strip: where the loops live now that the iPhone app has no Loops tab.

title: NavRail
description: The wide-window version of the tab bar: a rail of sections that collapses to icons.

title: PageDots
description: Under screens a thumb swipes through, when the count matters to the person.

title: Segmented
description: Two to four views of one thing, inside a card.

title: StatusPill
description: Top left of every screen, while she is doing something or has exactly one action to offer.

title: Steps
description: Where you are in a short flow, and what is still coming.

title: TabBar
description: The bottom of every iPhone screen: her talk button in the middle, the tabs either side of it.

title: Tabs
description: A few angles on one thing, under its title, with the ink sliding to the active one.

title: Toolbar
description: A bar of actions that belong together, docked in a screen or floating over the content.

title: BorderPattern
description: A pattern running along a rounded edge, one per moment: refreshing, listening, thinking, working, speaking, a question waiting, news, saving.

title: EmptyState
description: Nothing here yet, said properly: what this place is for and the one thing to do about it.

title: LoopBubble
description: One loop, small: its first letter in a disc and the six phases round it, the current one lit.

title: Progress
description: How far something is: a thin bar by default, or a ring with a value in the middle.

title: Skeleton
description: Anything loads from the house: blocks with a sheen in the shape of what is coming.

title: Snackbar
description: What happened next, next to the thing it happened to: one line and at most one action.

title: Tooltip
description: The name of a thing that is only an icon, on hover and on focus.

title: Anchor
description: The one personal note on a screen she builds for someone, beside the thing it is about.

title: LoopScreen
description: One loop in detail, as a whole screen.

title: Pattern
description: A moving fill behind a card, a header band or a screen strip, in the topic's two tints.

title: Pen
description: One mark on one piece of text, where a hand would have circled, underlined or ticked it.

title: PhaseRing
description: A loop as six phases, when the ring itself is the progress and not decoration round it.

title: ThemeWord
description: A word that carries one element or season, or the middle of a loop screen.

title: Topic
description: Once, high up, on every screen she builds for someone: it colours everything inside it.

title: Widget
description: One answer at a glance on a screen she builds for someone.

title: Word
description: One big word for a moment: a done moment, a number, a name.

title: BoardApp
description: Work that moves through stages: jobs, a hiring pipeline, a content calendar.

title: DashboardApp
description: A page of tiles that answers how it is going at a glance: a house, a shop, a campaign.

title: DocumentApp
description: Long text: a plan, notes, a report she wrote.

title: FlowApp
description: Anything with an end: book, sign up, set up a plugin, file a claim.

title: ListDetailApp
description: A collection you open one of: mail, notes, contacts, orders.

title: SidebarApp
description: Sections in a sidebar on the left, one view at a time: the default shape for an app with 3 to 7 places.

title: Surfaces
description: Choosing where something she built lands, from a line in the chat to a full app.

title: TableApp
description: Things of one kind you look through: what Iris did, the vault's logins, invoices, people.

title: TabsApp
description: One subject seen from two to five angles: a trip, a person, a project.

title: WidgetPagesApp
description: The phone home: pages of widgets, one theme per page, swiped with a dot rail.

title: Effects
description: Drawing attention: her LED edges, a neon line, a waiting question, the tour ring, pointing, pen marks.

title: WebKit
description: The web UI parts inside a topic: Chip, Progress, Stat, CheckList, Segmented, Field.

title: WidgetData
description: A showcase: the widget system filled with real demo content, over twelve topics.

title: WidgetGallery
description: A showcase: the four widget looks, each in the four sizes, with changing topics.

title: WidgetScreens
description: A showcase: widgets in use, as the widget lab has them, with scrolling and pictures.

title: Cover
description: The one title card of a set, chapter or share image: the word on the left, the look on the right.

title: All components
description: Every part of the system as a live picture. Pick one by how it looks.

title: A phone screen
description: One screen she builds for one person: one answer, one accent, one mark. The rules were settled in review and live in code.

title: A window she opens
description: The overlay she lays over the talk for one view: how big it is, what holds its edges, and what never goes inside it.
headings: What never appears in a window
How a window differs from a page

title: A loop
description: One thing that comes back: the six phases, the ring that shows them, and what the person can do while it runs.
headings: Waiting on you is the loud one

title: An app she builds
description: Several views, a way to move between them, its own data that is there tomorrow, and a shape that works in a small window, a full browser and a phone.
headings: Pick the smallest surface that holds it
Folding: the frame decides, not the screen
It uses the system's own controls

title: Search and finding
description: Where the field sits, what it shows while it waits, what an empty result says, and how filtering differs from asking the house.
headings: Filtering a list or searching a house

title: Settings and the You page
description: The You page is the reference for every settings surface: one column of glass rows, the value on the right, and danger last.
headings: The You page is the reference
What a setting may never do without saying so
A value that is still loading
States and tokens you may use

title: Loading and empty
description: A wait is never an empty black screen. Iris shows the shape of what is coming, then one line of what she is doing, then the thing.
headings: What a skeleton may not be
Progress, for work with a real end

title: Errors and refusal
description: Say what happened next to the thing that failed, in one sentence, with retry first. A refusal is not an error.
headings: Next to the thing that failed
What is never logged or shown
The one place an error may interrupt

title: Onboarding and permission
description: The first minutes ask once, say what for, and take one permission at a time. A refusal never disables the app.
headings: Ask once, and say what for
The order of the first screens

title: Talking and voice
description: Voice is a surface. The orb shows the state, the talk button is the mic, and every state has one word and one look.
headings: The talk button is the mic
The talk button in the tab bar

title: Install and bundle
description: Two stylesheets and three scripts. Everything in the system is on one global, window.IrisUi.

title: AI within the framework
